interface.shortDescription: Connect Nexts to the local DeckCraft desktop app.
interface.longDescription: Create and edit presentations, manage slides and shapes, and export decks through the local DeckCraft desktop control channel. Requires DeckCraft to be installed and running with its control port enabled (deckcraft --control 7990); the bundled MCP server connects to it with mcp --connect 7990. The control channel is loopback-only and unauthenticated, so no token needs to be configured. The plugin confirms the desktop app is reachable before editing, discovers available commands before execution, and keeps the deck visible in the desktop application.
